title: 집에 고장 난 곳이 있어요: 집주인·관리실에 알리기
objective: By the end, you can say what is broken in your home and where, and ask for a repair with '고쳐 주실 수 있어요?' or '언제 오실 수 있어요?'.
summary: Ten everyday words for describing problems in your home and asking a landlord or management office for a repair.

task.title: REPORT PROBLEMS, ASK FOR REPAIRS
task.line: Use the 10 words and the two request sentences to choose, fill in, arrange, or write the Korean.

words.meaning: to break down, to stop working (machines)
words.example: 세탁기가 고장 나서 빨래를 못 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: The washing machine broke down, so I can't do laundry.
Water is leaking from the bathroom ceiling.
The kitchen sink is clogged, so the water won't drain.

words.meaning: there is no hot water (from the tap or shower)
words.exampleMeaning: There has been no hot water since this morning.

words.meaning: a light goes out; the power goes out
words.exampleMeaning: The living room light suddenly went out.

words.meaning: the home boiler (heats the floor and the water)
words.exampleMeaning: Even with the boiler on, the room doesn't get warm.
Mold has appeared on the balcony wall.

words.meaning: landlord, owner of the house you rent
words.exampleMeaning: I sent photos to the landlord by text.

words.meaning: building management office (in an apartment complex)
words.exampleMeaning: I called the management office, but nobody is answering.
They say the repair technician will come tomorrow afternoon.

exercises: Choose the right word: ①욕실 하수구가 (막혀서 / 새서) 바닥에 물이 고였어요. / ②에어컨 밑에서 물이 (막혀요 / 새요). / ③(보일러가 / 곰팡이가) 고장 나서 방이 추워요.
Fill in the blanks with 곰팡이, 보일러, or 고장 나다 (change the form if needed): ①욕실 천장에 까만 ____가 많아요. / ②추워서 ____ 온도를 올렸어요. / ③냉장고가 ______ 음식이 다 상했어요.
Fill in the blanks with 집주인, 관리실, or 수리 기사: ①____ 전화번호는 엘리베이터 안에 붙어 있어요. / ②월세는 매달 25일에 ____에게 보내요. / ③____님이 공구를 가지고 와서 세면대를 고쳤어요.
Put the words in order to make a request: ①주실 / 현관문 / 있어요? / 고쳐 / 잠금장치를 / 수 ②수 / 내일 / 있어요? / 언제 / 오실

Write a short message in Korean: ①To the management office: there has been no hot water in the bathroom since yesterday. Ask them to fix it. / ②To your landlord: the kitchen light went out. Ask when they can come.
answers: ① 막혀서 ② 새요 ③ 보일러가
① 곰팡이 ② 보일러 ③ 고장 나서
① 관리실 ② 집주인 ③ 수리 기사
① 현관문 잠금장치를 고쳐 주실 수 있어요? ② 내일 언제 오실 수 있어요?
① 어제부터 욕실에서 온수가 안 나와요. 고쳐 주실 수 있어요? ② 부엌 불이 나갔어요. 언제 오실 수 있어요?
